title: Cat café together
genre: 社群宣傳片 / 第一人稱約會
source: Lines are copied from ai-companion backend/app/activities (outings.py fallback, choice_lines cat_cafe); a change there is not picked up here. The lines are spoken by the character (H3 dialogue), not burned in as subtitles (promo.subtitles = false). Risk: H3 distorts animals, so the cat only ever lies curled or asleep.

video.description: The woman in the first frame, in her sage-green knit sweater and blue jeans, has her fingertips resting on the back of the fluffy orange cat curled asleep on the table, and looks softly at the viewer. The woman (S1), in a clear, warm voice, spoken softly, with a natural Taiwanese Mandarin accent, says: <d>[Chinese] 好軟……牠在呼嚕。</d> Then she makes one slow, gentle stroke along the cat's back, glances down at the orange cat and lifts her eyes back to the viewer with a soft smile. The cat's belly rises and falls slowly as it breathes; its eyes stay closed and its body stays curled and still. The camera holds a steady shot.

continuity: Light only moves forward: afternoon (1-3) -> late afternoon (4-5) -> sunset (6). Same outfit in every shot: sage-green knit sweater, jeans. The sunlit window with its cushions is on the right of the frame in every shot and she looks and leans toward the right. The treats are only in shot 3; the orange cat sleeps on the table in the lower right from shot 3 on, and it only ever lies curled or asleep. Every shot ends facing the viewer.
